description: The night sky: a still star field behind the Start page, after Netscape Navigator's throbber, over a dark planet whose limb crests just below the Omnibar, with a comet or a shooting star now and then on a slow diagonal going out behind the limb, and streaks falling thick and fast from a commit until the page paints (#590). The browser draws it (src/ui/NightSky.qml); the website does not. Lengths are shares of the scene's width or height unless named otherwise; times are in seconds. A colour is a role (ground, light, glow, skyTop, skyLow, black, white) or a mix of two at an amount. A gradient stop is [position, colour] or [position, colour, alpha]. `crt` is the CRT glass the sky declares, which the host draws, with the road's amounts. `rest` is where the Omnibar rests, as a share of the height. `planet` is the dark planet rising from the bottom, after Navigator's globe: its limb crests `gap` CSS pixels below the resting Omnibar's hint row, which the browser hands in and which reaches `omnibarReach` below where the Omnibar rests at the theme's type size, its `radius` a share of the width, its face the ground darkened by `face`, its limb a line `width` CSS pixels wide (at `unlit` alpha of the light in a Private window, where it has no glow) and the glow along it `reach` CSS pixels out. `glint` is the light a passing comet casts on the Omnibar's rim, as the road's `light` is the sun's: an ellipse centred on the comet's head, `across` of the Omnibar's width and `reach` CSS pixels down, and the bloom over it.
name: Night sky
